title: Compute centre of mass and full inertia tensor
prompt: Implement solve(payload) where particles is a list of {"mass_kg":m,"position_m":[x,y,z]}. Return {"mass_kg":M,"center_m":[cx,cy,cz],"inertia_kg_m2":[[Ixx,Ixy,Ixz],[Iyx,Iyy,Iyz],[Izx,Izy,Izz]]} about the centre of mass, aligned with world axes. M=sum(m), c=sum(m*r)/M, I=sum(m*((r-c) dot (r-c)*identity - outer(r-c,r-c))). Off-diagonal entries have a minus sign. Zero masses are allowed but ignored. If any mass is negative return {"error":"negative_mass"}; otherwise if total mass is zero, including empty particles, return {"error":"zero_mass"}. Positions have magnitude <=1e6. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-8, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
